# Atharv Mittal

Interactive portfolio of Atharv Mittal — full-stack developer, security-trained,
product-obsessed. Founder @ Buildora. Rendered as an editor window: file-tree
sidebar, line-numbered buffers, ASCII rain, popup windows, and a security
terminal at /shell/.

## Pages

- / — README (home): intro buffer with the ASCII rain that draws the AM monogram.
- /about/ — who I am: the security-and-product loop, current work, stack.
- /resume/ — resume buffer (formatted CV content).
- /shell/ — interactive security terminal: real command set over a virtual filesystem.
- /404/ — lost-in-the-buffer page (not linked from the tree).

## Projects

- /projects/ — index of the six featured case studies.
- /projects/vulnswarm-vex/ — VulnSwarm-VEX: triages vulnerability alerts with Z3 and OSV/VEX data; 91.7% agreement with ground truth.
- /projects/adversary-lab/ — Adversary Lab: MITRE ATT&CK-mapped Sigma rules validated against Wazuh + Elastic.
- /projects/prompt-optimiser/ — Prompt Optimiser: Chrome extension that runs one prompt across several AI platforms; open source.
- /projects/eleventh-round/ — Eleventh Round: combat-sports product shipped as a paid Buildora client build.
- /projects/crypton/ — Crypton: Rust/Axum identity system replacing passwords and OTPs with WebAuthn.
- /projects/acctomatic/ — Acctomatic: OCR + n8n pipeline that reads, classifies, and flags accounting invoices.

## Archive

- /archive/ — index of eight earlier builds.
- /archive/tinyvulnscanner/ — multithreaded Python scanner with banner grabbing and basic XSS/SQLi checks.
- /archive/eduai/ — AI study scheduler that ingests Canvas LMS data into weekly plans.
- /archive/protopaper/ — hackathon frontend turning research PDFs into checklists and code scaffolds.
- /archive/billshield/ — product concept for disputing and tracking healthcare bills.
- /archive/ai-outfit/ — ML outfit recommender using clothing attributes, occasion, and season.
- /archive/blinks/ — webcam blink-detection interface for switch-scanning communication.
- /archive/buildora-agent-pipeline/ — 12-agent LangGraph pipeline with a real-time Next.js dashboard.
- /archive/android-app/ — Java Android app applying high-school CS concepts.
